ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Feb-19-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.
Petitioner, Ana Maria Santiago-Alamilla, was present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the minor Rachelle Benitez.
Petitioner was placed under oath and testified.
Dianna Linares was placed under oath and served as Spanish speaking interpreter for petitioner.
Proof of Publication in file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Rachelle Benitez Santiago.

Decree Changing Name was submitted and signed by the Court.

HEARING ORDERED FOR APPLICATION OF WAIVER OF COURT FEES
